project: Choose a support inbox for the launch team
research_question: Which option best supports a two-week product launch without adding heavy administration?

findings.claim: Option A can import the current shared inbox
findings.notes: The documented import covers messages and labels. Historical assignment data needs a separate export.

findings.claim: Option B has the fastest initial setup
findings.notes: A synthetic five-person workspace was ready in under thirty minutes.

findings.claim: Option C supports routing rules on the entry plan
findings.notes: The pricing table is ambiguous about whether advanced conditions require an upgrade.

findings.claim: Option A exposes conversation data through an API
findings.notes: The documented endpoints cover conversations, messages, tags, and assignees.

findings.claim: Option B may limit export access
findings.notes: Confirm the current export behavior with the vendor before making a recommendation.

findings.claim: Option C includes a public status page integration
findings.notes: Incidents can be linked to active support conversations.
